title: RH20T: A Comprehensive Robotic Dataset and Benchmark for High-Diversity Tabletop Manipulation
abstract_snippet: This paper presents RH20T, a comprehensive robotic dataset containing 20 different manipulation tasks with diverse objects and scenes, designed to address data scarcity in robotic manipulation learning.
data_bottleneck_focus: scarcity of high-diversity manipulation data; need for cross-embodiment coverage

title: Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models
abstract_snippet: We introduce the Open X-Embodiment dataset, a large-scale multi-robot dataset aggregated from 22 institutions, comprising over 2 million trajectories. We show that models trained on this dataset exhibit positive transfer to unseen embodiments.
data_bottleneck_focus: data fragmentation across labs; need for shared cross-embodiment data; positive transfer evidence

title: Bridge Data: Boosting Generalization of Robotic Skills with Cross-Domain Datasets
abstract_snippet: We present Bridge Data, a large-scale dataset of demonstration trajectories spanning multiple domains. We demonstrate that multi-domain data improves generalization of robot learning policies.
data_bottleneck_focus: single-domain overfitting; multi-domain data improves generalization

title: RoboCasa: Large-Scale Simulation for Everyday Robot Manipulation
abstract_snippet: RoboCasa is a large-scale simulation framework for training generalist household robots. It provides thousands of scenes and tasks with realistic physical interactions for synthetic data generation.
data_bottleneck_focus: synthetic-to-real gap (sim2real); scalability of simulated data; realism of physics and rendering

title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
abstract_snippet: RT-2 shows that large vision-language models co-fine-tuned on robot trajectory data enable emergent semantic reasoning and can be controlled via natural language, transferring web-scale knowledge to robotic control.
data_bottleneck_focus: need for paired action-language data at scale; leveraging web data reduces labeled robot data needs

title: DROID: A Large-Scale In-The-Wild Robot Manipulation Dataset
abstract_snippet: DROID is a large-scale diverse robot manipulation dataset collected across 13 institutions in 52 scenes, containing 76k demonstration trajectories. We highlight the importance of environment and object diversity over sheer trajectory count.
data_bottleneck_focus: diversity vs scale tradeoff; multi-institution data collection cost; sensor heterogeneity

title: RoboNet: Large-Scale Multi-Robot Learning
abstract_snippet: RoboNet aggregates video of robot-object interactions from many platforms into a single dataset, enabling cross-robot generalization of manipulation models.
data_bottleneck_focus: cross-embodiment data; foundation for X-embodiment research direction
